Graph envelopes are reported separately; GPU union uses actual kernel/copy/memset node intervals, not graph envelopes.
On-CPU thread time includes native driver spin. No scheduler trace or hardware performance counters were available; CPU/GPU residuals are not proof of cache/bandwidth or GIL causes.
Profiled windows are instrumentation diagnostics, not unprofiled FPS acceptance.
